steps.say: A suffix is a group of letters added to the end of a word. It changes the meaning or the job of the word.
The suffix -ful means full of. A helpful friend is full of help.
The suffix -less means without. A fearless explorer is without fear.
The suffix -ly tells us how something is done.
Watch the tricky ones. A consonant and y changes y to i, and -le changes to -ly.
Remember: -ful always has just one l.

options.why: A helper is a person who helps.

hints: -ful means full of. The ending you need means the opposite.
Look at the end of each word, not the start.
check.explanation: The suffix -less means without, so helpless means without help.

check.prompt:
Add -ly to sad.
Mei waved ___ as the bus drove away.
hints: The missing word tells us how Mei waved.
Sad does not end in y or -le, so it does not change.
Write sad, then add the two letters of the suffix.
check.explanation: Sad + ly = sadly. It tells us how Mei waved.
